build_construct_laplacian_hat: build a graph Laplacian matrix from log-potentials with optional single-root edge constraint
create_marginals: create edge marginals for dependency trees using log-potentials and Laplacian inverse-transpose
sample_wilson_multi_root: sample rooted spanning trees from directed graphs using Wilson's algorithm allowing multiple root edges
sample_generalized_wilson: sample a single spanning tree from log-potentials with optional single-root edge constraint
run_vectorized_sample_wilson: run vectorized Wilson sampling over batches of log-potential matrices with per-sample lengths
